_meta.warning: STALE DATA RISK: AoE2 DE is actively patched. Unit stats, civ bonuses, and tech availability change with every major update. Always verify against the current game version or patch notes before trusting specific numbers.
_meta.source: Handcrafted from community knowledge + SiegeEngineers aoe2techtree. Not extracted directly from .dat file.
_meta.civ_id_note: mgz civ_id mapping: 1=Britons, 2=Franks, 3=Goths, etc. civ_id=0 in save version 67.x may indicate Franks (off-by-one encoding change) — treat as uncertain if not confirmed by player.
_meta.arena_note: Arena starts with pre-built stone walls. Both players start in a walled base. Standard Dark Age boom → Castle Age push is the meta.

Franks.style: Cavalry boom. One of the best Castle Age civs due to cheaper Castles and high-HP Knights. Dominant eco from free farm upgrades.
bonuses: Farm upgrades (Horse Collar, Heavy Plow, Crop Rotation) are FREE — huge food eco advantage
Cavalry have +20% HP (Knights survive longer, better in prolonged fights)
Castles cost 25% less stone (~488 instead of 650) — faster Castle drops and defense
Foragers work 15% faster — strong early food off berries
Franks.unique_tech_castle: Chivalry — Stables work 40% faster (mass Knights faster)
missing_notable: Husbandry (cavalry slower than other cav civs)
Franks.arena_strategy: Boom to Castle Age fast. Castles cost less stone so you can drop one earlier. Immediately produce Knights with Bloodlines + Forging. Free farm upgrades mean your food eco compounds strongly. Avoid committing to archers — Franks' archer line is mediocre.
Franks.vs_cumans_note: Cumans will try to pressure with MAA + Battering Rams. Franks can afford a Castle earlier than most civs (stone discount). Aim to have your Castle up at ~18:00 and immediately start Knight production. If walls hold, your eco advantage compounds hard.

Cumans.style: Fast Feudal aggression + second TC boom. Unique ability to field Battering Rams in Feudal Age. Transition to cavalry in Castle Age.
bonuses: Can build a SECOND Town Center in Feudal Age (50% of normal stone cost) — enables economic snowball
Can build Siege Workshop in Feudal Age — ONLY civ that can field Battering Rams in Feudal/early Castle transition
Siege weapons move 10% faster per age tier (Feudal +10%, Castle +20%, Imperial +30%)
Palisade Walls have +50% HP in Feudal Age
Unique tech 'Nomads' allows the second Feudal TC even if researched later
Cumans.unique_unit: Kipchak (cavalry archer, attacks multiple times per shot at higher levels)
Cumans.unique_tech_castle: Steppe Husbandry — Cavalry Archers and Steppe Lancers train 60% faster
Cumans.unique_tech_imperial: Cuman Mercenaries — allied players can train 10 free Kipchaks from their Castles
Cumans.team_bonus: Cavalry Archers have +1 attack in Feudal Age
Cumans.arena_strategy: Fast Feudal (~8:30 click) → Barracks in Dark Age → Militia spam → Man-at-Arms upgrade → Siege Workshop in Feudal → Battering Rams → break walls in Castle transition. Second TC in Feudal massively accelerates eco. Transition to Kipchaks + siege in Castle/Imperial.
Cumans.vs_franks_note: Franks have cheaper Castles and high-HP Knights which beat Cuman cavalry in head-to-head. Win condition is breaking through walls before Franks mass Knights. If Franks get 5+ Knights out, switch to siege support.

Britons.style: Foot archer boom. Best late-game archers in the game. Strong on open maps; viable on Arena with tower/range-focused play.
bonuses: Foot archers (except Skirmishers) have +1 range in Castle Age, +2 in Imperial
Town Centers cost 50% less wood from Castle Age onwards (easier to age and expand)
Shepherds work 25% faster
Archery Ranges are 20% cheaper from Feudal Age
Britons.unique_tech_castle: Yeomen — Foot archers +1 range, Towers +2 attack
Britons.unique_tech_imperial: Warwolf — Trebuchets do splash damage and 100% accuracy
Britons.arena_strategy: Boom to Castle, produce Crossbowmen/Arbalests + Longbowmen from multiple Archery Ranges. Yeomen gives exceptional range advantage. Cheaper TCs let you build a second TC quickly.

Goths.style: Infantry flood. Extremely cheap infantry allows overwhelming numbers in Imperial Age. Weak walls and limited defensive options.
bonuses: Infantry cost 35% less in Imperial Age (25% Feudal, 30% Castle — staggered)
Villagers +5 attack vs wild animals (safe luring)
+10 population headroom above cap in Imperial Age
Infantry creation speed +2.5 per age tier (very fast barracks)
Goths.unique_unit: Huskarl (infantry, high pierce armor — counters archers hard)
Goths.unique_tech_castle: Anarchy — Huskarls can be made from Barracks
Goths.arena_strategy: Tough on Arena — Goths lack good walls and defensive tools. Try to boom and time an Imperial Age infantry flood. Huskarls from Barracks (Anarchy) are nearly immune to archer-tower defenses.

Teutons.style: Defensive slow push. Strongest Paladins, conversion resistance, cheap farms, powerful Towers and Castles.
bonuses: Towers garrison twice as many units and have double garrison arrows
Murder Holes free (Towers and Castles can attack at minimum range)
Farms cost 40% less
Monks +2 conversion resistance (harder to convert your units)
Town Center +2 attack in Castle Age, +2 more in Imperial
Teutons.unique_unit: Teutonic Knight (very slow but highest melee attack + armor infantry)
Teutons.unique_tech_imperial: Crenellations — Castles +3 range, garrisoned infantry shoot arrows
Teutons.arena_strategy: Very strong on Arena. Cheap farms + powerful towers = easy to defend. Boom to Imperial, spam Paladins. Crenellations turns your Castle into a devastating fixed defense.

Japanese.style: Versatile infantry + navy. Very fast-working eco buildings. Strong on water and viable on land with infantry.
bonuses: Mills, Lumber Camps, Mining Camps work 10%/15%/20% faster per age (massive eco speed)
Fishing Ships have 2x HP and +2 Pierce Armor and work faster
Trebuchets +2 accuracy
Infantry have +1/+2 attack in Castle/Imperial Age
Japanese.unique_unit: Samurai (infantry, very fast attack, bonus vs unique units)
Japanese.unique_tech_imperial: Kataparuto — Trebuchets fire and pack 3x faster
Japanese.arena_strategy: Fast eco buildings help accelerate boom. Strong Castle/Imperial infantry + siege push. Samurai are useful if opponent spams unique units.

Chinese.style: Eco powerhouse. Start with extra villagers (6) but less food. Very cheap tech upgrades per age. Versatile in Castle+.
bonuses: Start with 6 villagers instead of 3 (but -150 food, -50 wood)
Technologies cost 15% less food/wood in Feudal, 15% less food in Castle, 15% food in Imperial
Town Center supports 10 population instead of 5
Demolition ships have +50% HP
Chinese.unique_unit: Chu Ko Nu (crossbowman that fires multiple arrows per shot)
Chinese.unique_tech_castle: Great Wall — Stone Walls and Gates +30% HP
Chinese.unique_tech_imperial: Rocketry — Chu Ko Nu +2 attack, Scorpions +4 attack
Chinese.arena_strategy: 6 villager start means faster build-up but requires early food micro. Cheap techs help you age faster. Versatile — archers, siege, or infantry are all viable.

Byzantines.style: Defensive counter-civ. Cheaper counter units, strong late-game with access to almost every tech. Good on closed maps.
bonuses: Spearmen, Camels, Skirmishers cost 25% less (cheap counter units)
Buildings have +10%/16%/20%/25% HP per age
Fire Ships +20% attack
Advance to Imperial Age costs 33% less
Byzantines.unique_unit: Cataphract (cavalry, bonus vs infantry, immune to anti-cavalry bonus damage)
Byzantines.unique_tech_imperial: Logistica — Cataphracts do trample damage and +6 attack vs infantry
Byzantines.arena_strategy: Very strong defensively. Cheap Skirmishers and Spearmen let you counter anything cheaply. Boom to Imperial and use your full tech tree access. Cataphracts are devastating vs infantry blobs.

Persians.style: TC + Dock eco boom. Fastest villager and fishing boat production. War Elephants for late game. Strong Castle Age timing.
bonuses: Town Centers and Docks work 10%/15%/20% faster per age
Start with +50 food and +50 wood
Knights have +2 attack vs archers (Cavalry Archers)
Town Centers and Docks have double HP
Persians.unique_unit: War Elephant (massive HP, high attack, slow)
Persians.unique_tech_imperial: Kamandaran — Archers cost wood instead of gold
Persians.arena_strategy: Fastest Feudal TC means fastest villager output early. Strong fast Castle timing. War Elephants are powerful but expensive — need a gold-heavy economy.

Saracens.style: Stable gold eco + strong siege. Unique market that generates gold. Strong Camel and archer play.
bonuses: Market transactions cost only 15% (instead of 30%) — very efficient gold trading
Transport Ships have 2x HP and 2x capacity
Archers (non-siege) have +3 attack vs buildings
Monks can garrison in Monasteries for protection
Saracens.arena_strategy: Market efficiency lets you sell excess resources and buy needed ones cheaply. Strong Crossbow + Arbalest vs buildings. Camels counter Knights effectively.

Turks.style: Gunpowder and gold mine. Free gold mining upgrades. All gunpowder units have +25% HP. Strong late-game only.
bonuses: Gunpowder units have +25% HP
Gold Mining upgrades are free
Chemistry is free (skips the Feudal/Castle requirement)
Light Cavalry and Hussar upgrades are free
Turks.unique_unit: Janissary (Hand Cannoneer with higher HP and better stats)
Turks.unique_tech_imperial: Artillery — Bombard Towers and Cannons have extra range
Turks.arena_strategy: Weak early game — no Crossbow upgrade means very limited Feudal/early Castle options. Boom to Imperial for Janissaries and Bombard Cannons. Rely on Hussars as fast cheap mobile force.

Vikings.style: Infantry eco. Free Wheelbarrow and Hand Cart saves significant food. Strong navy. Decent infantry in all ages.
bonuses: Wheelbarrow and Hand Cart are free (saves ~500 food — huge eco acceleration)
Infantry have +10%/15%/20% HP per age (Castle/Imperial/+)
Warships cost 15% less
Berserkers self-heal over time
Vikings.unique_tech_castle: Chieftains — Infantry have +5 attack vs cavalry
Vikings.arena_strategy: Free eco upgrades save ~500 food early — spend it on military earlier than normal. Viking infantry + siege push is reliable. Chieftains makes infantry counter Knights effectively.

Mongols.style: Mobile siege and cavalry archers. Fastest siege destruction. Dominant open-map raiding civ.
bonuses: Siege Weapons fire 25% faster (Mangonels, Scorpions, etc.) — devastating in mass
Cavalry Archers have +30% HP in Castle, +40% in Imperial
Hunters carry twice as much food
Scout Cavalry line has +2 Line of Sight
Mongols.unique_tech_castle: Nomads — Houses don't need to be rebuilt after destruction
Mongols.unique_tech_imperial: Drill — Siege Workshop units move 50% faster
Mongols.arena_strategy: Less dominant on Arena than open maps. Drill + fast siege can break walls quickly. Mangudai are expensive but nearly unkillable vs siege-heavy compositions.

Celts.style: Fast infantry + aggressive siege. Strongest foot infantry speed. Siege fires fast. Unique Woad Raiders.
bonuses: Infantry move 15% faster (fastest foot soldiers in the game)
Siege Weapons fire 25% faster
Lumberjacks work 15% faster (strong wood eco)
Enemy Monks convert Celt sheep less than 25% of the time
Celts.unique_tech_castle: Stronghold — Castles and Towers fire 20% faster
Celts.unique_tech_imperial: Furor Celtica — Siege Workshop units +40% HP
Celts.arena_strategy: Fast infantry can apply pressure quickly once through the wall. Siege + Woad Raiders is the signature push. Wood eco bonus helps pump Siege Workshops and Lumber Camp upgrades.

Spanish.style: Missionary gold eco. Missionaries (mounted monks) are unique. Cannon Galleons and Conquistadors are powerful.
bonuses: Blacksmith upgrades cost no gold (huge gold savings)
Builders work 30% faster (buildings complete much faster)
Cannon Galleons fire 15% faster and have improved ballistics
Trade units generate +33% more gold
Spanish.unique_unit: Conquistador (mounted hand cannoneer) and Missionary (mounted monk)
Spanish.unique_tech_imperial: Supremacy — Villagers +15 attack, +40 HP, +8 armor (villager wars civ)
Spanish.arena_strategy: Free Blacksmith upgrades = major military advantage for the same gold cost. Fast builders help you boom and place military buildings quickly. Conquistadors are devastating if you can reach Castle Age.

Aztecs.style: Infantry + Monk rush. Garrisoned units generate gold. Eagle Warriors replace cavalry. Very strong eco with Atlatl.
bonuses: Villagers carry +5 resources
Military units created 11% faster
Monks +5 HP per Monastery technology researched
Start with +50 gold
Garrisoned units generate 0.7 gold/min — passive income
Aztecs.unique_unit: Jaguar Warrior (infantry, massive bonus vs other infantry)
Aztecs.arena_strategy: No cavalry — Eagle Warriors fill that role (fast, bonus vs Monks). Monk rush is extremely powerful with high-HP Monks. Garrisoned TC generates passive gold early.

Maya.style: Archer eco boom. Start resources last 15% longer. El Dorado Eagle Warriors are near-impossible to kill. Strong eco.
bonuses: Starting resources last 15% longer (more from each gold mine, lumber, etc.)
Villagers cost -10%/-15%/-20% per age (much cheaper villagers in Castle+)
Eagle Warriors available (replaces cavalry)
Plumed Archers are strong mid-game archer unique unit
Maya.unique_unit: Plumed Archer (fast foot archer, good HP)
Maya.unique_tech_castle: Obsidian Arrows — Archers +6 attack vs buildings
Maya.unique_tech_imperial: El Dorado — Eagle Warriors +40 HP (nearly unkillable)
Maya.arena_strategy: Cheaper villagers let you maintain eco with less investment. Plumed Archers are fast and can raid effectively. El Dorado Eagles are devastating in Imperial.

Huns.style: No need to build houses (saves wood + time). Best Cavalry Archer civ. Aggressive early game.
bonuses: Do not need Houses — never hit population cap from house supply (massive early advantage)
Cavalry Archers cost -10%/-20% in Castle/Imperial
Trebuchets are +30% more accurate
Start with -100 wood (offset by not needing houses)
Huns.unique_unit: Tarkan (cavalry, bonus vs buildings, fires arrows)
Huns.unique_tech_imperial: Atheism — Wonders and Relics victory require 100 more years; opponents' Monastery income -50%
Huns.arena_strategy: Never wasting food/wood on Houses is the key advantage — every resource goes directly to military or eco. Strong Castle Age cavalry archer spam. Tarkans shred walls and buildings.

Koreans.style: Tower + Siege specialist. Strongest towers in the game. Excellent navy. Unique War Wagon cavalry archer.
bonuses: Stone Miners work 20% faster
Towers have +2 range (Watch Towers have Guard Tower range)
Villagers reveal enemy Stealth Forests
Military buildings require 20% less stone
Siege Weapons have +1 range in Castle, +2 in Imperial
Koreans.unique_unit: War Wagon (armored cavalry archer cart) and Turtle Ship
Koreans.unique_tech_castle: Eupseong — Watch Towers and Guard Towers have +2 range
Koreans.arena_strategy: Super strong on Arena — Stone Miners generate huge stone income for towers and Castles. Tower + Castle combo is near-impenetrable. Siege Weapons have exceptional range.

Italians.style: Cheap age-ups and Docks. Genoese Crossbowmen counter cavalry. Condottieri counter gunpowder. Strong on water.
bonuses: Advancing through ages costs 15% less food/gold
Dock technologies cost 50% less
Fishing Ships work 10% faster
Genoese Crossbowmen have bonus vs cavalry
Gunpowder units cost 15% less
Italians.unique_unit: Genoese Crossbowman (archer with bonus vs cavalry) and Condottiero (infantry, bonus vs gunpowder)
Italians.unique_tech_imperial: Silk Road — Trade units cost 50% less
Italians.arena_strategy: Cheap age transitions mean you can commit more food/gold to villagers and military. Genoese Crossbowmen are strong vs Knight-heavy opponents.

Hindustanis.style: Strongest Camel civ. Cheap Camel upgrades. Powerful gunpowder. Strong Elephant unique unit.
bonuses: Camel units have +10 HP and +1/+1 armor — strongest Camels in game
Camel upgrades cost 50% less
Villagers have +1 attack per age vs buildings (good for breaking walls)
Gunpowder units cost 10% less
Hindustanis.unique_unit: Camel Rider (stronger than standard camel) and Ghulam
Hindustanis.unique_tech_castle: Grand Trunk Road — All units generate gold with each kill
Hindustanis.team_bonus: Camel units have +4 attack vs buildings
Hindustanis.arena_strategy: Camels are the answer to Knight-heavy civs. Grand Trunk Road turns a large army into a gold generator. Ghulam are effective vs archer masses.

Incas.style: Defensive eco + unique buildings. Kamayuks (anti-cavalry infantry) and Slingers. Extra villager at start.
bonuses: Start with a free Llama (bonus food animal)
Villagers +5 HP per Fortress technology (tougher villagers)
Farm upgrades cost 75% less
Walls and Towers built 50% faster
Unique buildings: Storehouse, Stronghold
Incas.unique_unit: Kamayuk (spearman with +1 range, strong vs cavalry) and Slinger (anti-infantry ranged)
Incas.unique_tech_castle: Andean Sling — Slingers have no minimum range
Incas.unique_tech_imperial: Couriers — Kamayuks and Slingers have +0/+2 armor
Incas.arena_strategy: Strong defensive eco with cheap farm upgrades. Kamayuks are powerful vs cavalry-heavy opponents. Build high walls fast (50% build speed bonus).

Magyars.style: Free Forging + Scout line. Strong cavalry scouts (free upgrades) and Cavalry Archer play.
bonuses: Forging, Iron Casting, Blast Furnace are free (no gold cost for attack upgrades)
Scout Cavalry and Light Cavalry are free upgrades
Villagers can kill wolves immediately (no risk)
Magyar Huszar requires no gold
Magyars.unique_unit: Magyar Huszar (fast cavalry, no gold cost, bonus vs siege)
Magyars.unique_tech_castle: Corvinian Army — Magyar Huszar has no gold cost
Magyars.unique_tech_imperial: Recurve Bow — Cavalry Archers +1 attack, +1 range
Magyars.arena_strategy: Free attack upgrades (Forging etc.) save significant gold — invest it in more knights or cavalry archers. Magyar Huszar counters siege weapons for free.

Slavs.style: Eco-friendly Siege + Boyar cavalry. Farms work faster. Strongarm Siege (Onagers/Mangonels) is devastating.
bonuses: Farms generate food 10% faster
Military buildings cost 15% less wood
Supplies free (Militia line cost reduced — Militia don't cost gold to upgrade to Man-at-Arms)
Detinets unique building converts some unit production
Slavs.unique_unit: Boyar (heavy cavalry, very high melee armor)
Slavs.arena_strategy: Faster farms + cheaper military buildings = strong eco + military balance. Druzhina infantry trample is powerful vs blob compositions. Team bonus Siege Workshops are very strong.

Portuguese.style: Gold discount on all units. Fastest exploration. Feitoria generates all resources passively.
bonuses: All units cost 15% less gold — major late-game sustainability
Ships have +10% HP
Researching technologies 25% faster
Unique building: Feitoria (generates food/wood/stone/gold passively)
Portuguese.unique_tech_imperial: Arquebus — Gunpowder projectiles have improved ballistics
Portuguese.team_bonus: Allies get notifications when enemy builds Wonders or Castles
Portuguese.arena_strategy: 15% gold discount on all units means your army is more cost-efficient. Feitoria can sustain a post-gold-mine economy. Tech speed bonus helps you age and upgrade faster.

Ethiopians.style: Free unit upgrades when aging up. Strong Shotel Warriors (fast infantry) and Organ Guns.
bonuses: Receive free Pikeman and Elite Skirmisher upgrades when advancing ages
+100 food and +100 gold when advancing ages
Towers and Outposts have +3 attack
Torsion Engines free (Onager splash damage upgrade)
Ethiopians.unique_unit: Shotel Warrior (very fast infantry, high attack) and Royal Heirs variant
Ethiopians.unique_tech_castle: Royal Heirs — Shotel Warriors train nearly instantly
Ethiopians.unique_tech_imperial: Torsion Engines — Siege Weapons have larger blast area
Ethiopians.arena_strategy: Free Pikeman + Skirmisher on aging means instant counter units. +100 food/gold per age helps maintain economy during transitions. Tower attack bonus synergizes with Arena's walled nature.

Malians.style: Infantry attack bonus per age. Strong eco from Gbeto. Free Gold Mining upgrades.
bonuses: Infantry have +1 attack per age starting in Feudal (up to +3 in Imperial)
Gold Mining upgrades are free
Buildings cost -15% stone
Gbeto (unique unit) is a powerful ranged infantry
Malians.unique_unit: Gbeto (female ranged infantry, fast, good damage) and Farimba
Malians.unique_tech_castle: Tigui — Town Centers shoot arrows even without garrison
Malians.arena_strategy: Free gold mining upgrades + stone discount on buildings help boom efficiently. Infantry +attack bonus makes even basic infantry dangerous in Imperial.

Berbers.style: Camel and cavalry speed. Genitour (mounted skirmisher) unique. Cheap Stables.
bonuses: Stables cost 25% less
Genitour available as allied unit
Cavalry move 10% faster in Castle, 15% in Imperial
Villagers cost 15% less from Castle Age
Berbers.arena_strategy: Cheap villagers from Castle Age help maintain eco while producing military. Fast cavalry is excellent for raiding once walls are breached. Kasbah speeds up building placement.

Khmer.style: No building prerequisites — can skip straight to advanced units. Battle Elephants. Farms automatically reseed.
bonuses: No building technology prerequisites — can build University without advancing, Siege Workshop without Barracks, etc.
Battle Elephants move 10% faster
Villagers can garrison in Houses
Scorpions fire 25% faster in Imperial
Khmer.unique_unit: Ballista Elephant (mounted Scorpion) and Battle Elephant line
Khmer.unique_tech_imperial: Double Crossbow — Ballista Elephants fire two projectiles
Khmer.arena_strategy: No prerequisites means you can rush a Siege Workshop or University without the normal building chain — surprising on Arena. Battle Elephants are powerful but slow and expensive.

Malay.style: Fast age-up + unique harbor. Cheapest Fishing Ships. Battle Elephants. Harbor generates free ships.
bonuses: Advancing through ages costs 66% less food (massively cheaper age-ups)
Fishing Ships are 33% cheaper
Fish traps cost -33% wood
Battle Elephants are available (unique to Southeast Asian civs)
Malay.unique_unit: Karambit Warrior (cheapest unit in game — 25 food 15 wood)
Malay.unique_tech_castle: Thalassocracy — Docks upgraded to Harbors (attack nearby enemies)
Malay.unique_tech_imperial: Forced Levy — Militia line costs only food (no gold)
Malay.arena_strategy: Age-ups costing 66% less food is game-changing — reach Castle Age much faster. Forced Levy Militia/Champions cost no gold — a nearly unlimited infantry supply.

Burmese.style: Lumber eco + Infantry buff. Free Lumber Camp upgrades. Arambai (cavalry archer) is devastating.
bonuses: Lumber Camp upgrades are free (big wood eco savings)
Monks reveal the position of all relics at the start
Infantry have +1/+2 attack in Castle/Imperial
Elephants cost -25%
Burmese.unique_unit: Arambai (cavalry archer, very high damage, poor accuracy — devastating in mass)
Burmese.unique_tech_imperial: Manipur Cavalry — Cavalry and Arambai +6 attack vs standard buildings
Burmese.arena_strategy: Free lumber upgrades = strong wood eco from the start. Arambai mass is a potent Castle Age push. Monks revealing relics helps early relic control.

Vietnamese.style: Defensive eco awareness + strong archers. Imperial Skirmisher. Rattan Archer is tough to kill.
bonuses: Start with a free extra Villager
Enemy units visible on minimap at game start (full intelligence on opponent's position)
Imperial Skirmisher available
Each technology researched gives +10% HP to a random military unit type
Vietnamese.unique_unit: Rattan Archer (foot archer with very high pierce armor)
Vietnamese.unique_tech_imperial: Paper Money — Generates periodic gold tributes to allies
Vietnamese.arena_strategy: Seeing opponent's TC position at start is irrelevant on Arena (everyone knows where walls are), but extra villager helps eco. Rattan Archers are very hard to counter with archers or skirmishers.

Bulgarians.style: Militia line is strongest in game. Blacksmith upgrades faster. Konnik cavalry unique unit.
bonuses: Militia line upgrades (Man-at-Arms, Long Swordsman, etc.) cost 50% less food and are researched 50% faster
Blacksmith works 80% faster
Buildings cost -25% stone
Town Centers can research Feudal-age Kreposts (mini-Castles)
Bulgarians.unique_unit: Konnik (cavalry that fights on as infantry when killed) and Stirrups unique tech
Bulgarians.team_bonus: Cavalry attack 33% faster (from Stirrups being free for team in some patches — verify)
Bulgarians.arena_strategy: Cheap, fast Militia upgrades mean very cost-efficient Man-at-Arms spam. Krepost provides a cheap defensive structure. Stirrups makes cavalry attacks extremely fast.

Tatars.style: Cavalry Archer excellence. Flock bonuses. Unique Keshik earns gold. Sheep give extra food.
bonuses: Sheep generate 50% more food
Cavalry Archers have +1 attack height bonus (fire from high ground more effectively)
Trebuchets have +50% splash damage radius
Elevation bonus for ranged units doubled
Tatars.unique_unit: Keshik (cavalry that generates gold on each attack) and Flaming Camel
Tatars.unique_tech_castle: Silk Armor — Cavalry Archers and Steppe Lancers +1/+1 armor
Tatars.unique_tech_imperial: Timurid Siegecraft — Trebuchets and Mangonels have extra range
Tatars.arena_strategy: Extra food from sheep provides early eco boost. Keshik generates gold passively during combat — strong in prolonged fights. Timurid Siegecraft trebuchets have exceptional range for siege.

Lithuanians.style: Cavalry buff from relics. Start with +150 food. Leitis (cavalry) ignores armor.
bonuses: Start with +150 food (biggest food bonus in the game)
Each Relic garrisoned in a Monastery gives cavalry +1 attack (up to +4 with 4 relics)
Spearman line attacks 33% faster
Town Centers support 10 population
Lithuanians.unique_unit: Leitis (cavalry, bonus attack ignores melee armor) and Winged Hussar
Lithuanians.unique_tech_castle: Hill Forts — Town Centers have +3 range
Lithuanians.unique_tech_imperial: Tower Shields — Spearman/Pikeman/Halberdier have +2 pierce armor
Lithuanians.arena_strategy: +150 food start means you can click Feudal significantly faster. Relic hunting is critical — each relic gives +1 cavalry attack. Leitis ignoring melee armor makes them deadly vs well-armored Knights.

Burgundians.style: Early eco upgrades available one age early. Unique Coustillier cavalry has charge attack.
bonuses: Economic upgrades available one age earlier than normal (Horse Collar in Dark Age, Wheelbarrow in Feudal, etc.)
Cavalier upgrade available in Castle Age
Flemish Revolution (UT) converts all villagers to powerful militia-equivalent
Vineyards convert food to gold periodically
Burgundians.unique_unit: Coustillier (cavalry with charge attack that deals massive burst damage)
Burgundians.unique_tech_castle: Burgundian Vineyards — Mills generate food + gold
Burgundians.unique_tech_imperial: Flemish Revolution — All Villagers become Flemish Militia
Burgundians.arena_strategy: Eco upgrades one age early is a massive advantage — get Wheelbarrow in Dark Age, Heavy Plow in Feudal. Coustillier charge attack deals devastating burst damage against clustered units.

Sicilians.style: Defensive Castle Age. Donjon unique building. Serjeants defend Castles. Farm discount on first farms.
bonuses: First 5 buildings of each type cost -100% stone
Castles and Towers can garrison twice as many units
Units resist half the damage from first arrow volley (First Crusade tech)
Farm upgrades (food cost) are free starting in Castle Age
Sicilians.unique_unit: Serjeant (infantry that can build Donjons) and Donjon (unique building)
Sicilians.unique_tech_castle: First Crusade — Military units get +35 HP for a moment when created, Serjeants +3 attack
Sicilians.unique_tech_imperial: Scutage — Each enemy unit killed generates gold
missing_notable: many late-game cavalry and archer upgrades
Sicilians.arena_strategy: Free first-5-building stone cost means your first Castle, Watch Towers, and Donjons are nearly free. Strong defensive play. Serjeants can build Donjons inside enemy base.

Poles.style: Stone generates gold. Folwark replaces Mill. Obuch (infantry) strips armor over time.
bonuses: Stone Miners generate gold (stone mining generates 33% gold in addition to stone)
Folwark building collects 10% of nearby farm food automatically
Knights generate gold when killing units
Cavalry have +1 attack per age from Feudal
Poles.unique_unit: Obuch (infantry that permanently reduces target's melee armor each hit) and Winged Hussar
Poles.unique_tech_castle: Szlachta Privileges — Knight line costs 60% less gold
Poles.unique_tech_imperial: Lechitic Legacy — Obuch do trample damage
Poles.arena_strategy: Stone mining generates gold passively — mine stone aggressively for both Castle-building and gold income. Obuch stripping armor makes them powerful vs well-armored opponents. Knight line costs almost no gold with Szlachta.

Bohemians.style: University + Monk tech rush. Houfnice (upgraded Bombard Cannon). Strong gunpowder + monk synergy.
bonuses: Mining Camp upgrades are free
Monks are 50% cheaper
Hand Cannoneers and Petards are available in Castle Age
